recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 中以小型、深染、圓形的淋巴球為主，夾雜少數核稍大且不規則的中型細胞，以及細胞質豐富、核呈泡狀的組織球，並有微血管與細膠原穿插；缺乏大片大型異型細胞，符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的細胞組成。
features: Predominance of small lymphocytes with round, dense, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Admixed medium-sized cells with slightly larger, irregular nuclei
Scattered histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and vesicular, oval nuclei
Large atypical cells are rare (clearly less than 30% of the infiltrate)
Delicate capillaries and thin collagen strands traverse the infiltrate
No necrosis, angiocentricity or prominent eosinophils seen
describe_en: High-power H&E section of a dermal infiltrate shows a predominance of small lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei, admixed with medium-sized lymphoid cells with mildly irregular nuclei and scattered histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei. Thin capillaries and collagen strands traverse the infiltrate. Large atypical cells are infrequent, and there is no necrosis or angiocentric destruction. Findings are consistent with a small/medium-sized lymphoid infiltrate compatible with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, confirmed by a CD4-predominant T-cell phenotype with PD-1-positive medium-sized cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous peripheral T-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: PTCL shows more than 30% large pleomorphic cells, often with necrosis, ulceration and rapid growth.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous involvement by angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: AITL shows systemic lymphadenopathy, arborizing high endothelial venules, expanded CD21+ dendritic meshworks and EBV-positive B blasts, not a solitary cutaneous nodule.
Pseudolymphoma has a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, plasma cells and reactive follicles and lacks a clonal PD-1-positive T-cell population.
